The supplied image is a style, pose, color and identity reference only: extract and recreate ONLY the specified illustration; do not recreate a page or screenshot.
Style: polished flat Corporate Memphis editorial illustration, bold solid color shapes, crisp vector-like edges at full native resolution, expressive elongated limbs, oversized clothing, simplified faces, deep cyan-black hair, emerald green, cobalt blue, pink, coral and warm yellow.
